mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_users WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_users WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM system_oauth2_access_token WHERE deleted = 0 AND expires_time > NOW()

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM system_users WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{beginTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `date`

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(*) AS loginCnt, IFNULL(SUM(result = 0), 0) AS successCnt FROM system_login_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND log_type IN (100, 101, 103, 104) AND create_time >= #{beginTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY `date`
SELECT log_type AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM system_login_log WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY log_type
SELECT result AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM system_login_log WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY result
